tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab ma nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge don gnyer kun smon zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra ki la ya/ bla ma mchog dang 'phrin las phur bu'i tshogs/ /bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad la/ /za nyal chag gi rnal 'byor gus pas 'dud/ /phyi ma bde ba can du drangs su gsol/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams kyi phyag rgya'i gar 'cham dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab ces bya ba sngar nged rang gis byas pa de nyid la nye bar mkho ba'i 'cham skad rnams dang / phra phyag rnams kyi phyag rgya 'cha' tshul/ nub tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang bstun dgra bgegs grub 'cham tshul rnams dang / gzhan yang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod chen mo'i skabs su mkho ba'i phyag len 'ga' zhig rnams sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang / de'i thugs sras rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros gnyis kyi phyag bris dngos las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin 'dir bri bar bya'o/ /de la thog mar rtsa 'chams kyi 'cham skad rnams brjod par bya ste/ sa gzhi khod snyoms par bya ba'i phyir 'cham bskor lan gsum gyis gtan la dbab pa/ chos kyi dbyings bskyed par bya ba'i phyir bskor ba lan gsum bya ba/ snang srid dbang du bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir g.yab mo lan gsum bya ba/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed par bya ba'i phyir gsig gsig lan gsum bya ba/ dam nyams kyi bla 'gugs par bya ba'i phyir mgo gug 'di gnyis 'cham dpe la gong 'og bzhugs tshul 'di bzhin yod kyang phyag len la go brjes nas mdzad pa lags/ lan gsum bya ba/ bsrung ma rnams 'bod par bya ba'i phyir gcugs pa lan gsum bya ba/ steng phyogs byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir gnam 'khor lo rtse brgyad du bri ba/

bar byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir logs bkra shis rtags brgyad du bri ba/ 'og byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir sa padma 'dab brgyad du bri ba/ rdo rje phyed 'gros kyis sa btsal ba/ rdo rje rkyang 'gros kyi sa btul ba/ rdo rje rgya gram sbal 'gros rigs kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yam̐ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng bam̐ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /ram̐ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /lam̐ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /rin chen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / /dpal chen po'i 'gying chen/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chung / g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me phung 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /dbu ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur bris/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la bstob/ /steng dang shar gyi phyag brnyan ni/ /rdo rje dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /me dang lho yi phyag brnyan ni/ /dbyug tho dang ni dbyug pa 'dzin/ /bden bral nub kyi phyag brnyan ni/ /ral gri dang ni padma 'dzin/ /rlung dang byang gi phyag brnyan ni/ /rdo rje dang ni rgya gram 'dzin/ /dbang ldan 'og gi phyag brnyan ni/

/rdo rje dang ni tho ba 'dzin/ /steng dang shar gyi phra men ni/ /dril bu dang ni rnga yab 'dzin/ /me dang lho yi phra men ni/ /me dpal dang ni dgra sta 'dzin/ /bden bral nub kyi phra men ni/ /zhags pa dang ni sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /rlung dang byang gi phra men ni/ /'khor lo dang ni be con 'dzin/ /dbang ldan 'og gi phra men ni/ /rtse gsum dang ni gtun shing 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'jigs byed ser mo zhags pa 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /gsod byed ljang khu dril bu khrol/ /dam can spyi yi bskul 'chams/ shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /phra men ma bam̐ len gyi 'cham zhes pa de yan gyi 'cham skad rnams bshad zin nas/ da ni phra phyag rnams kyi phyag rgya 'cha' tshul brjod par bya ste/ de yang steng dang shar gyi phyag brnyan ni/ kha nang bltas dus lag g.yas steng du rdo rje 'dzin tshul gyis mtho bar 'phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub lta bu'i bandha snying khar bzung / kha phyir bstan dus lag g.yon gong bzhin la/ g.yas mdun du brkyangs/ khu tshur kha gyen bstan las mdzub mo lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ me dang lho'i phyag brnyan gyi phyag rgya la/ kha nang bstan gyi lag stabs ni lag g.yas mdun du brkyangs te dbyug tho 'dzin tshul dang / g.yon brla g.yon steng brkyangs/ kha phyir bstan gyi lag stabs ni/ lag g.yas dpung steng g.yas su dbyug pa 'dzin tshul gyis mtho bar brkyangs g.yon gong bzhi/ bden bral nub kyi phyag brnyan gyi phyag rgya la/ kha nang bltas kyi lag g.yas kyi mthe'u chung dang / srin mdzub mthe bong gis mnan/

gung mdzub gnyis ral gri'i tshul du brkyangs te mdun g.yon zur nas lag g.yon 'og nas g.yas zur bar gcod pa'i tshul dang / g.yon snying khar cung zad brgyangs/ kha phyir bstan gyi lag stabs/ g.yas dpung g.yas steng du kha gyen bstan du padma 'dzin tshul gyis cung dma' bar bya/ g.yon gong bzhin no/ /rlung dang byang gi phyag brnyan gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyir bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis dpung pa g.yon steng ser mo bsnol la thal mo sbyar/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas 'phral te mdzub mo brkyangs nas mdun phyogs su rgya gram bri tshul bya ba'o/ /dbang ldan 'og gi phyag brnyan gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyi bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis dpung gnyis kyi steng du brkyangs la g.yas rdo rje 'dzin tshul bya/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas g.yon pa'i phrag gong bzhag la tho ba 'gel tshul byed pa'o/ /de yan gyis phyag brnyan rdzogs nas/ da ni phra men rnams kyi phyag rgya brjod par bya ste/ steng dang shar gyi phra men gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyir bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du kha thur bstan 'byar la khad du dril bu 'dzin tshul lo/ /gnyis pa ni g.yon de nyid las g.yas mdun du rnga yab g.yob tshul lo/ /me dang lho'i phra men gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyi bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yas khu tshur dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du cung zad brgyangs pa me thab 'dzin tshul dang / g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub bya/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas kyi sor mo bzhi bsgrengs/ mdun du dgra sta 'debs tshul byed pa'o/ /bden bral nub kyi phra men gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyir bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis mdun du lag mgo gnyis rgyab sprod du bsnol nas brkyangs te zhags mig gi tshul du byed/

gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las g.yas phral nas mdun du sbrul zhags 'khyug pa'i tshul bya ba'o/ /rlung dang byang gi phra men gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyir bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yon pa thugs khar bandha kha gyen bstan du bzung / g.yas pa'i gru mo de nang du bcug g.yas khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyangs te 'khor lo bskor tshul du byed/ gnyis pa ni de nyid las g.yas kyi mdzub mo bskums/ mkhrig ma nang du gug pa be con 'dzin tshul du byed pa'o/ /dbang ldan 'og gi phra men gyi phyag rgya ni/ kha nang bltas phyir bltas dang bstun/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum lcags kyu ltar gug pa dpung g.yas steng mtho bar 'phyar zhing / lag g.yon brla steng g.yon par brkyangs/ gnyis pa lag g.yon de nyid las g.yas pa gsang gnas kyi thad ma reg tsam du gru mo cung zad gug cing / lag mgo kha phyir bstan gyi gtun shing 'dzin tshul bya/ de rnams kyis phra men gyi phyag rgya rdzogs nas/ zhar byung sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya 'cha' tshul brjod na/ de yang shar sgo ma'i phyag rgya ni/ lag g.yon bandha nu ma gnyis kyi thad tsam du kha gyen bstan du bzung / g.yas kyi gru mo ban nang du bcug khu tshur kha phyir bstan gyi mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar dgug pa'o/ /lho sgo ma'i phyag rgya ni lag gnyis rol pa ltar brgyangs pa zhags pa 'dzin tshul lo/ /nub sgo ma'i phyag rgya ni/ lag g.yas dpung g.yas steng du 'phyar zhing / g.yon dpung g.yon steng sbyar la zhags pa'i lcags sgrog mtho dma'i tshul lo/ /byang sgo ma'i phyag rgya ni/ lag mgo gnyis dpung steng gnyis su 'byar la khad kyi dril bu 'dzin tshul lo/ /'dir 'phros don nyer mkho cung zad brjod na/ chos kyi dbyings bskyed pa/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba sogs nas/ 'og byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bskyod 'gros/ rdo rje rgya gram/

keng rus/ rin chen lnga las grub pa/ rdo rje'i khyung gshog yum chen/ phyag brnyan phra men gyi 'og phyogs pa gnyis/ byang sgo ba rnams la bskyed 'gros/ gzhan rnams la 'cham tshul dang bstun pa'i ldem 'gros gcig brdeg dang / bzhi brdeg kho na'o/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa nas/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chen yan la 'jol stabs/ 'gying chen nas byang sgo'i bar grol bsdu/ byugs pa'i rdzas gsum la phur bskor te phur rtse phyi la nges par ston pa mdzad/ me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi zur gsum ka la rol mo che ba brdeg go /e las ma dang / yam̐ las rlung chen gnyis la dzam̐ g.yas su gnon/ wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon du gnon/ thod rlon la rna ba g.yon gyi rtsa bar dzam̐ gsum byas la rol mo che ba drug la mdun nas bskor/ rna ba g.yas su slob pa dang dzam̐ gsum byas/ slar g.yon du ldog la grol bsdu bya/ stag lpags ni skyed pa'i lta zur g.yas su dzam̐ gsum byas la rol mo che bzhi la stag gi sham thabs dkri tshul gyi mdun nas bskor la g.yon du sleb pa dang grol bsdu bya/ bam̐ brtag pa la g.yas nas g.yon pa la rol mo che gsum/ brtag pa la chung gsum g.yon la'ang de mtshungs/ g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yon pa la rol mo che bzhi dang / brtag pa la chung gsum yin no/ /da ni nub lam bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang bstun/ dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham tshul rnams ston pa la/ de'i sngon 'gro'i rnga 'cham gyi gser skyems la gu ru'i snyan dbyangs dang / 'jam po'i 'khyil 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i dbyangs 'khor dang po la/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod/ /gnyis pa la/ khyad par phur bu'i lha tshogs mchod/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis/ /gsum pa la/ phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /tshig rnams rdzogs mtshams su 'jam po'i 'khyil 'jam la/

'cham dpon gyis rnga brda sprad nas/ rnga gshed chung ba gsum gyi g.yas su gcam nas/ de nas rnga shed chung ba dal ba lnga la 'gro phyogs 'gro /drug pa la rnga shed che ba dang bstun/ yongs phyogs su log la sngar bzhin du rnga shed chung ba dal ba lnga'i bar la yongs phyogs su phyin la/ drug gi dus 'gro phyogs su log la rnga shed chung ba gnyis dang / che ba gcig brdungs la kha do rar blta ba ni 'jam po'i 'khyil 'cham mo/ /de nas phur kha bsgyur ba la/ che 'dzin gyi 'gying dbyangs dang / rin po che'i 'dur 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i rnga steng brdungs dang bcas dbyangs 'khor dang po la/ do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi ston no/ /lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs/ /phur lam gnyan po da phye zhig /gnyis pa la tshig gong 'og 'dra ba la/ bar gyi btsan laྎ gsum pa tshig gong 'og 'dra ba las/ 'og gi klu laྎ tshig rnams rdzogs mtshams su rin po che'i 'dur 'cham la 'chams dpon gyis rnga brda sprad la/ g.yas phyogs su steng brdungs ngang nas rnga chung snyoms gsum la gcam pa'i/ bzhi lnga zhes pa btud de myur bar brdungs shing / rnga nam khar bslangs la phyir brdungs du bsgyur nas gcig gnyis gsum rnams la 'gro phyogs su blta zhing / bzhi lnga zhes pa gong ltar mgyogs myur brdungs la/ yang gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga rnams la rnga steng bsgyur 'og bsgyur dang bcas rgyab 'gros bya/ de 'dra ba'i mdun 'gros dang rgyab 'gros lan gsum gyis/ gsum pa'i rgyab 'gros tshab tu chos 'byung rtse 'gro phyogs bstan pa rnga shed che ba gsum gyi bar la bri/ bzhi lnga la rnga mgyogs par brdungs zhing rgyab phyogs blta/ de nas chung gsum la kha yongs phyogs blta zhing / rkang g.yas kyi sgyid par rkang g.yon gyi pus mo btsugs la sdod/ bzhi lnga zhes pa gong bzhin brdungs la rnga chung ba lnga'i bar la rgyab 'gros dang /

yang lnga'i bar la mdun 'gros/ yang rgyab mdun la 'gro ba gnyis te lan gsum bskyar nas byas pa'i rjes rnga shed che ba lnga'i bar la chos 'byung rtse yongs phyogs bstan pa 'di la chos 'byung gi zur rkang pa g.yas kyi 'bri ba lan gnyis dgos so/ /bris la/ de ltar chos 'byung ltag sprod bris grub pa dang rnga shed chung che ba lan lnga brdung zhing kha yongs phyogs nas rgyab la bskor te do rar blta ba ni rin po che'i 'dur 'cham mo/ /'di'i rgyab mdun la rnga phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur gyi 'gro ba la shang shang 'gros zhes zer ba legs/ de nas nga rgyal bskyed pa la bde ba'i brjid dbyangs dang / nor bu'i skor 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i dbyangs 'khor dang po la/ hūm̐ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /thugs nang 'bar ba'i srog kyang zhugs/ /gnyis pa la/ tshogs brgyad spyi bo rkang mthil rnams/ /khro bo khro mo'i bdag nyid gnas/ /gsum pa la/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /dbyangs rnams rdzogs mtshams su 'cham dpon gyis rnga brda sprad la/ de nas nor bu'i bskor 'cham ni/ de nas bzhi brdungs chung ba'i gcig dang gnyis la g.yas su gcam la gsum dang bzhi la rnga sa la mnan cing nam mkhar bteg kha 'gro phyogs bskor nas rgyab phyogs la cung zad blta/ de nas gcig dang gnyis la de khar 'gying zhing / gsum dang bzhi la rnga rgyab nas dal bu'i bskor kha nang du blta/ rnga nyal stabs su 'khyer/ de 'dra ba'i 'cham tshul bzhi brdungs chung snyoms bdun gyi bar byas la/ bdun pa'i gsum pa dang bzhi pa la lnga shed che bar byed/ yang bzhi brdungs gcig la kha rgyab la blta ba sogs gong bzhin/ yang bzhi brdungs gcig la gong bzhin kha mdun phyogs blta zhing / rnga g.yas phyogs 'khyer la/ gsum dang bzhi la rnga shed che bar bya/ yang bzhi brdungs gcig la kha rgyab phyogs blta/ yang bzhi brdungs gcig la kha mdun phyogs blta/

de nas bzhi brdungs la rnga shed che bar brdungs la/ chos 'byung rtse phyir bstan bris/ kha yongs phyogs bltas la/ gcig dang gnyis la rkang g.yas kyi sgyid khugs su rkang g.yon gyi pus mo btsugs la 'gying zhing / gsum pa dang bzhi bzhi brdungs 'di gong 'og gnyis ka'i bzhi brdung gi grangs la mi bgrang / pa la rnga g.yas zur du yo ba dang bcas/ gong dang 'dra ba'i bzhi brdungs chung snyoms drug dang / bzhi lnga zhes pa la rnga shed che bar brdung ba gnyis rnams gong dang 'dra bar song rjes rnga shed che ba lnga la chos 'byung rtse phyir bstan bris la/ kha do ra'i nang du blta ba ni nor bu'i bskor 'cham mo/ /de nas dpang gzugs la/ rdo rje'i 'tsher dbyangs dang / dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i dbyangs 'khor dang po la/ rgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin dang / /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ /gnyis pa la/ khyad par phur bu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /gsum pa la/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas/ /de ltar legs par bzung du gsol/ /tshig dang po rnams kyi dbyangs rdzogs mtshams su 'cham dpon gyis rnga brda sprad rjes tshig gnyis pa rnams kyi dbyangs dang bstun/ dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham bya ste/ de yang dbyangs mi shes pa rnams kyis grangs 'di bzhin bgrangs kyang don tshang bas/ de'i tshul ni rang rang gi g.yas phyogs su rnga brdeg gcig dang gnyis kyi bar gcam la/ gsum pa'i dus mdun nas bskor zhing kha 'gro phyogs blta/ bzhi dang lnga la rkang g.yas bteg tsam byas/ drug la rkang g.yon bteg la bzhag bdun la rkang g.yon bteg tsam byas bzhag la kha nang la blta/ brgyad pa la rnga g.yas phyogs phab cing rkang g.yas bzhag yang dgu pa la rkang g.yas bteg rnga mdun nas bskor zhing kha 'gro phyogs blta/ bcu dang bcu gcig la rkang g.yon bteg tsam byas la bzhag bcu gnyis pa la rkang g.yas bteg lus nem gsig che bar bya/

bcu gsum pa la yang rkang g.yas bteg tsam byas la bzhag bcu bzhi pa la rkang g.yon bteg tsam dang / bco lnga pa la rkang g.yon bteg cing bzhag la kha nang du blta/ bcu drug pa la rnga g.yas phyogs bsnyal la rkang g.yas bteg la bzhag bcu bdun pa la yang rkang g.yas bteg la g.yas zur phab/ bco brgyad pa la rkang g.yon phab ste/ de nas dbyangs rdzogs pa'i ba'i ba'i zhes pa'i dus rnga shed che ba brdungs la rnga g.yon zur sa la phab/ rnga yu lag pa g.yas pa'i gru mo'i 'og tu yong bar byas la thur brdungs chung snyoms bzhi byas/ yang chung bzhi la rnga g.yas zur 'phyar/ rnga yu g.yon phyogs gang babs bstan la gyen brdungs bya/ de bzhin lan gsum byas nas thur brdungs che ba bzhi'i bar la lus gsig cing mnan la/ de nas 'theng brdungs che ba gnyis la rkang g.yon dang rnga bteg tsam bteg tsam ngos mdun nas g.yas phyogs bskor zhing sa la phab tsam phab tsam byas/ rkang g.yas yang g.yon dang 'dra bar mnyam por bskor la kha rgyab la blta/ yang gong bzhin bzhi brdungs gcig gi gcig dang gnyis che ba dang / gsum dang bzhi chung bar brdungs/ rnga g.yon zur 'bebs pa dang / g.yas zur 'degs pa dang / g.yon zur 'bebs pa rnga chung brdungs sogs gong bzhin lan gsum song rjes bzhi la rnga thur brdungs ngos rkang pa g.yas rgyab nas sa la drud cing bskor/ g.yon zhar byung du bskor nas kha nang la blta/ de nas bzhi brdungs bya zhing / rnga 'og brdungs kho na dang / rkang pa g.yas brkyangs pas rtse gsum 'bri ba ni dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham mo/ /de nas sbug chol dung chen sogs dang bstun/ rnga g.yom g.yas g.yon re mos kyis lan lnga byas la/ de nas 'theng brdungs dang bstun 'gros ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ slar yang gong bzhin rnga g.yom byas la rdo rje phyed pa bris/ yang rnga g.yom dang 'gros ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes rnga g.yom byas la rdo rje rkyang 'gros bris/ yang rnga g.yom dang 'gro sogs sngar bzhin byas la rdo rje rgya gram bris la/

der rjes rnga g.yom gyi rjes 'theng brdung gi 'gros kho nas 'cham dpon gyi rjes la 'cham sna ba mthud nas 'theng brdung je myur je myur du btang ba shin tu 'grig pa'i ngos nas log go /rdo rje 'di rnams 'bri tshul rtsa 'cham sgra ji bzhin yin pa dang / rnga steng brdungs 'og brdungs bya ba sogs zhib par 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub tu gsal bas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis der gzigs pa zhu/ de rnams kyis sngon 'gro rnga 'cham gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bstan zin nas/ dngos gzhi dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham dngos mdzad pa la/ skabs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon slob rags bsdus dang bcas pas bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ gser skyems bsdus pa/ rig 'dzin bskul/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ lha bsrung spyan drangs ba/ nga rgyal bskyed pa/ dipta tsakra/ ling ga bsgral yul sogs dang / rgyud gsum bla ma rnams mdzad do/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon/ rnga brdungs pa/ dung / rgya gling / dar pa sogs lag khyer ba rnams dang bcas/ 'cham khang gi sgo sogs 'byon pa'i gdong der rnga brdungs pa phyogs gcig dang / lag 'khyer ba gzhan tsho zhal sprod tshul du bsgrigs/ spos phor sogs su me tsha ba la gu gul sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa na bun 'thib pa lta bu shin tu zil che bar bsregs/ de nas rol mo dung sogs 'bud dkrol rngam brjid dang ldan pa gcam shing gsum brdungs lan can grub mtshams/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin gyi dbyangs dang bcas pas/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i bskul rnams rim pa bzhin las/ dzaṃ nyug dang po pu tra'i lnga brdung gis bskul la/ hūm̐ rab brjid rngam pa'i zhal gdang mche ba gtsigs/ /dmar ser skra brdzis thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs 'dzin yang sprul nyi shu po/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bskul la/ dur khrod sha za sogs sho lo ka gcig gi rjes su 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang /

/dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'cham tshul 'cham dpe bzhin las brgyad brdung gsum dang dgu brdung dgu yin no/ /de nas dzam̐ nyug gnyis pa them pa bar 'jug gi bskul la/ hūm̐ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya mo/ /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig /de nas dzam̐ nyug gsum pa pu tra'i dgu brdung gi bskul la/ hūm̐ 'jigs rung dmar nag me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /shin tu khros pa dam nyams tshar gcod cing / /sgrub po skyong mdzad dam can bcu gnyis po/ /ma rung 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /de nas mgo brnyan gyi bskul la/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin sogs nas/ dom dang byi ba'i mgo bo'i bar dang / de'i mjug tu/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed sogs/ /dam nyams sgrol ba'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes sbyor/ de nas 'cham pa rdo rje slob dpon dpon slob thams cad byon te rkyang 'gros kyi do ra 'khor ba dang / ling ga dgug gzhug tshar gsum byas rjes pad skor gcig byas/ dzam̐ lan lnga'i rjes su rkyang 'gros 'khor cig go /de nas dngos gzhi la seng ge'i brjid 'cham ni pad bskor gcig dzam̐ lnga'i rjes su rol mo che ba gcig la rkang g.yas bteg lag gnyis brgyangs nas sdod/ de nas g.yas bskor du rol mo lnga'i bar la bskor zhing / mthar gong bzhin pad bskor dang / dzam̐ 'gros 'khor gcig de 'dra ba lan gsum gyi dang po la rkyang 'gros/ de nas nyis 'gros dang g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du g.yab pa spel ma byed pa'o/ /stag mo'i rngam 'cham la pad bskor dzam̐ sogs 'dra/ de nas lnga brdeg bcu gcig gi bar la g.yas bskor byed/ pad bskor 'gros nyis 'gros so/ de 'dra lan gsum/ spyang mo'i 'dur 'chams la pad bskor dbus su gcig de nas rkang g.yas rkang g.yon gyi rgyab tu spos la pad bskor gcig byas la lag g.yon sked gzer byas/

lag g.yas g.yob tshul dang bcas rkang g.yas mdun phyogs su rol mo dal po lan bzhi'i bar du spod/ de nas bzhi brdeg drag myur gnyis la mdun du mchongs la/ 'theng rkang gcig la kha g.yon du phyogs rgyab la mchongs nas pad bskor gcig byas la/ lag g.yas sked gzer ba sogs g.yas g.yon go spos la byed/ 'theng rkang gcig po kha mdun du phyogs la rkang gnyis bgrad/ lag gnyis brgyangs nas rgyab phyogs su phyir 'gros su mchongs la pad bskor gcig dang dzam̐ nyis 'gros sogs 'dra/ de 'dra ba gsum/ dred mo'i rgyug 'cham la dbus su pad bskor gcig rkang g.yas rkang g.yon gyi rgyab tu spos la pad bskor gcig yang rkang g.yon rkang g.yas kyi rgyab tu spos la pad bskor gcig yang gong bzhin rkang g.yas rgyab tu spos la pad bskor gcig ste pad bskor bzhi byas la/ rol mo 'theng brdungs chung ba gnyis gnyis la/ g.yon zur dang g.yas zur du dzam̐ gnyis gnyis/ de nas 'theng brdungs che ba gnyis la lus g.yon phyogs su gsig pa che ba dang bcas pa'i g.yon ngos su dzam̐ gnyis/ de nas rkang g.yas bteg nas mdun du spos la g.yas phyogs su lus gsig pa dang dzam̐ gnyis/ yang rkang g.yon mdun du spos la gong bzhin dzam̐ gnyis dang / pad bskor gcig byas rjes rol mo bzhi brdeg gsum la khyi nyal byed/ de nas pad bskor gcig byas la rol mo bcu gcig bar la lag g.yon sked gzer dang / g.yas g.yob cing / rkang g.yas cung zad tsam re bdun phyogs su spod/ rol mo rdzogs nas mdun drang por rkang g.yas sleb pa dang / bzhi brdeg gnyis la mdun du mchongs tshul bya/ 'theng brdungs gcig la kha g.yon phyogs bltas la rgyab tu mchongs la pad bskor gcig bya/ lag g.yas sked gzer dang g.yon g.yob cing / rkang g.yon cung zad tsam re mdun phyogs su rol mo bcu gcig gi bar du spos tshar ba dang bzhi brdeg gnyis la mdun du mchongs/ 'theng rkang gcig la rgyab tu mchongs/

'theng rkang gcig la mdun du mchongs/ yang rgyab tu gong bzhin mchongs nas pad skor gcig dzam̐ dang 'gros gong bzhin no/ /de 'dra lan gsum gyi rting ma la rkyang 'gros byed/ de nas ling ga la yang dgug gzhug tshar gcig byas rjes lnga brdeg gsum la lag gnyis re mos kyis 'phyar la g.yas g.yon du 'gying byas tshar ba/ mdun du lag gnyis re mos kyis brkyangs pa lnga brdeg bzhi la dzam̐ gyi tshul bya/ de nas lag gnyis brgyangs te g.yas bskor du dgu brdeg cig gi bar la bskor la bdun la g.yon du mnan/ dgu la g.yas su g.yab/ 'theng brdungs gnyis la g.yon dang / g.yas su dzam̐ lcags 'then byed/ de nas bzhi brdeg gsum bzhi'i bar la bzhi 'gros byed pa 'di ni gdab kha dngos rnams la'ang chems brdungs kyi rjes la byed do/ /de nas dam tshig chen po'i dbyangs dang bstun nas byed/ bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab/ /ces pa dang g.yas phyogs su 'phar zhing bzhi brdeg gcig la pad bskor byas nas lag g.yon sked gzer dang / g.yas g.yob tshul bya zhing dgu brdeg gcig gi bar rkang g.yas cung zad spos la rol mo rdzogs nas rkang g.yas mdun du sleb pa dang / lus g.yas phyogs nas gcus shing bzhi brdeg gsum gyi bar la lag g.yas mdun du pus g.yas 'og nas gri bskor gyi tshul gyi gsum bskor/ yang g.yon phyogs su 'phar zhing bzhi brdeg gcig la pad bskor byas nas mdun du bskor ba sogs g.yas g.yon go spod pa tsam yin yang / lag gnyis brgyangs rgyab phyogs su 'phar zhing bzhi brdeg gcig la pad bskor byas nas 'then rkang gsum la g.yas g.yon g.yas rnams su dzam̐ lcags 'then dang / bzhi brdeg gsum bzhi'i bar la 'gros byed pa gdab tshul lo/ /de nas/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /zhes pa'i rjes la yang gdab tshul gong bzhin byed/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /ces pa dang g.yas phyogs su 'phar zhing bzhi brdeg cig la pad bskor gcig byas nas 'theng rkang bzhi'i bar la dzam̐ lcags 'then gyi tshul re mos su g.yon dang g.yas su lan gnyis re byed/

mthar chems brdungs dang ling ga sgrol ba sogs byed/ de nas gdab kha'i 'cham thams cad gong bzhin no/ /gdab kha drug pa'i chems brdungs mjug tu lnga brdeg gsum gyi 'gying tshar ba dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs dang bstun nas 'chams shing / tshig dang po la rkang g.yas bteg nas g.yon phyogs la 'gro zhing g.yas phyogs su mchongs/ gnyis pa la rkang g.yon bteg nas g.yas phyogs la 'gro zhing g.yon phyogs la mchongs/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa gong bzhin re mos byed/ rdzogs pa dang g.yas g.yon du gnyis gsum re mchongs la mthar chems brdungs ngos ling ro rnams phul lo/ /de nas bzhi 'gros kyis nang du log go /de rnams kyis dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham tshul mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ da ni gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod mdzad skabs kyi phyag len nyer mkho 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang thog mar chog bsgrigs kyis bsgrig dgos/ sa chog nas sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / sa sbyangs pa dngos kyi rang gi mig g.yas pa nas/ bdag gis don yod dkyil 'khor bri zhes pa'i bar mdzad/ gzhan rnams bsgrig mi dgos/ sta gon la/ lha sta gon nas bsgrigs pa'i lha sta gon gyi mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang ba nas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi bar mdzad/ gzhan rnams mi bsgrig dngos gzhi nas bdag 'jug dang / gzhug tu bkris mdzad/ gzhan rnams bsgrig mi dgos/ de rjes tshogs skad gang 'os gtong / steng stabs nas bsgrig dgos pa'i hūm̐ chen ka ra'i dbyangs dang / steng phyogs tshangs bsnol ma yas mtha' mas mtha' bsdus pa/ de nas kī la ya'i 'gros tshar gcig mdzad/ gzhan 'dur ma dang / steng yang ma rnams mi mdzad/ der rjes tshogs skad gang 'os gtong / phur bsgrub sa 'dul gyi 'cham sbyong snga ma la rol 'gros nas brtsams/ mgo gug yan la pad bskor re re/ snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang / mkha' 'gro dpa' bskyed pa gnyis/

steng 'og bar gsum rdo rje rkyang 'gros rnams la lnga pad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rgya gram/ me/ sa/ rakta/ keng rus rnams la pad skor gnyis re/ rin chen lnga las grub pa dang / dam can spyi'i bskul 'cham nas/ sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros kyi bar sogs la 'cham grul po kha yar mdzad pas/ pad bskor sku ngal gso ba sogs kyi stabs gang 'os mdzad/ gzhan thams cad la pad bskor re re/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros tshar gnyis re/ rgya gram tshar gcig mdzad/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nas/ rakta'i bar tshar gnyis re mdzad/ rakta dang keng rus mang tsam mdzad/ 'cham sbyong rjes ma la/ lnga pad dgos pa rnams dang / sku ngal gso ba'i pad bskor sogs ma gtogs thams cad la pad bskor re re mdzad/ rakta keng rus mang tsam/ gzhan 'cham sna tshang ma re re mdzad/ ja dang po keng rus sod mtshams zhu/ de'i gnyis pa/ byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor song mtshams su zhu/ sa 'dul gyi sku 'cham dngos gzhi'i nyin gang 'os su bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ gser skyems rgyas pa/ rig 'dzin bskul/ phur kha bsgyur ba rnams mdzad/ 'cham dngos gzhi'i nyin mgo gug yan la pad bskor gsum re mdzad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros tshar gsum/ rgya gram gnyis mdzad/ gzhan rnams grangs mang nyung pad bskor sogs 'cham sbyong snga ma lugs mdzad/ 'cham ja gsum yong ba'i/ dang po sngan ma mgo gug song 'tshams zhu/ de'i gnyis pa keng rus song mtshams zhu/ 'di'i rjes la khrung dang zho dkrugs zhu/ bar ma'i dang po yum chen song 'tshams zhu/ 'di'i gnyis pa mi 'gro 'di'i rjes la yang khrung dang zho dkrugs zhu/ rjes ma'i dang po byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor song mtshams zhu/ sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros grub 'phral gnyis pa skor ja zhig dang / khrung sogs gong bzhin zhus la zhal dkar thams cad bsdu/ sgrub mchod grol kha'i dgra bgegs grub kyi 'cham sbyong snga ma la/ rnga 'chams la dbyangs 'khor dang po gnyis re dang /

'cham skor gnyis re mdzad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros gnyis dang / rgya gram gcig mdzad/ grub 'cham la rkyang 'gros song mtshams dgug gzhug tshar gcig mdzad/ der rjes 'theng rkang gi ngang nas pad bskor dang rkyang 'gros ji ltar rigs pa mdzad rjes/ seng ge'i brjid 'cham nas/ dred mo'i rgyug 'cham bar thengs gnyis re mdzad/ der rjes dgug gzhug mi mdzad chems brdungs rdzogs la gdab kha'i 'cham tshar gcig mdzad/ de nas gdam tshul gnyis dang / gdab kha drug tshig yas mtha' mas mtha' sbyar ba'i yongs rdzogs mdzad/ phyi nang gsang ba shlau ka gcig yongs rdzogs mdzod/ 'cham sbyong rjes ma la rnga 'cham gyi dbyangs 'khor rjes ma re dang / 'cham 'khor re re mdzad/ rdo rje gsum tshar re re mdzad/ grub 'cham la dgug gzhug gong bzhin/ seng ge'i brjid 'cham nas brtsams tshar re re mdzad/ gdab tshul gnyis dang / gdab kha khro bo chen po rdo rje gsang ba/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /sogs tshig yas mtha' mas mtha' sbyar ba'i gdab kha gsum po mdzad/ phyi nang gsang ba tshig yas mtha' mas mtha' gnyis mdzad/ ja dang po seng ge'i brjid 'cham song mtshams zhu/ gnyis pa gdab tshul gnyis song mtshams zhu/ 'cham dngos gzhi'i nyin rnga 'cham la dbyangs 'khor gsum dang / 'cham 'khor gsum re mdzad/ rdo rje phyed 'gros dang rkyang 'gros gsum re/ rgya gram gnyis mdzad/ grub 'cham la rkyang 'gros song mtshams dgug gzhug tshar gsum/ yang rkyang 'gros dang / seng ge'i brjid 'cham nas/ dred mo'i bar tshar gsum re mdzad/ der rjes dgug gzhug tshar gcig de nas gdab tshul gnyis dang / gdab kha drug phyi nang gsang ba rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad pa la 'cham ja gsum gyi sngon ma'i dang po/ bla ma rig 'dzin dbyangs 'khor gsum song mtshams zhu/ gnyis pa rgyud gsum ma'i dbyangs 'khor gcig gnyis gang rigs song mtshams zhu/ 'di'i rjes la khrung dang zho dkrugs sogs zhu/

ja bar ma'i dang po seng ge'i brjid 'cham gnyis gsum song mtshams zhu/ gnyis pa spyang mo song mtshams sam/ dred mo gcig gnyis gang rung song mtshams zhu/ rjes ma'i dang po gdab tshul gnyis song mtshams zhu/ gnyis pa pho nya bran dang sogs gdab kha gsum song mtshams zhu/ gnyis pa gnyis kyi rjes la khrung sogs gong bzhin zhus rjes zhal dkar thams cad bsdu/ drug 'cham kyi thog ma'i dgug gzhug gsum song nas 'theng rkang ni bcams/ de nas rkyang 'gros bskor gcig dang / seng ge'i brjid 'chams nas spyang mo thub 'chams dpe bzhin/ spyang mo la g.yas log gcig g.yas g.yob pa bzhi dang / mdun la mchongs rgyug bzhi brdungs gnyis sogs 'cham dpe bzhin/ g.yon 'gre/ dred mo'i rgyug 'cham la g.yas log g.yon log gsum/ khyi nyal song nas/ lag g.yas 'phyar la drangs bzung la g.yas nas bskor zhing dgu la mdun du phab/ gdab tshul la g.yas log gcig dang / lag g.yas 'phyar la drangs bzung nas bdun la phab pa sogs gzhan thams cad 'cham dpe bzhin no/ /zhes rdo rje phur pa'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge don gnyer kun smon zhes bya ba 'di yang / grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can dang / thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i rnam par sprul pa gdon mi za ba sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs sen rin po che dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i 'khon gyi sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor rnams la dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa bcos min yang dang yang du thob pa la brten/
